name: Argument map
note: Put the claim at the top. Reasons begin with Because and objections with But; hang the evidence under each and answer objections with However. An objection with no However is where the case is weakest.
outline: Because the air would be cleaner
Bus stop NO2 above legal limit
However, drop-off bays at both ends
But side streets would get busier
title: Pedestrianise the high street
